description: Leaf spot refers to localized fungal or bacterial lesions that form discrete spots across the Aloe leaf surface, commonly aggravated by moisture.
symptoms: Small circular to irregular brownish spots scattered across leaf blades
Spots may possess yellowish chlorotic halos surrounding necrotic centers
May coalesce into larger dry, necrotic patches in severe cases

sanitation.step: Prune severely spotted individual leaves to halt progressive infection to neighboring foliage.
sources: General Plant Pathology Principles (Agrios, Plant Pathology 5th Ed)

sanitation.step: Clean and disinfect pruners between each cut with 70% alcohol.

cultural.step: Avoid wetting foliage during irrigation; keep leaf surfaces dry.
Position plants where air circulation is active to deter ambient leaf surface humidity.
